thread:
Maria: Morning folks — planning to cut the release branch tomorrow. Quick laundry list before I open the PR:
- Branch name: `release/1.17.0`? 
- RC tag flow: CI creates rc/x after tests, then we branch? 
- Backport policy reminder (last two patch lines?)

Kevin: Sounds right. If this batch includes features (not just fixes) do minor bump. What's in the batch?

Maria: It's a mix: KV-cache eviction improvements + a perf tweak for short-sequence routing. Non-breaking. Also a crash fix in the offline loader.

Song: Confirming policy: backport to last two maintained patch branches by default. For security or data-loss issues escalate to @security and we can make an exception.

Carla: I'll prepare the changelog entry. Drafting now:
```
### 1.17.0 (unreleased)
- perf: route short sequences to fast-kernel fallback (@kevin)
- fix: KV cache eviction to reduce tail latency (@carla)
- fix: avoid NPE in offline model loader (#4321)
```
Anyone want to reword or add links to PRs?

Kevin: Add the PR numbers inline for the perf tweak (e.g. #4378) and mark the loader fix as `fix:` like you did. 

Maria: @release-bot can you schedule the branch creation for tomorrow 09:30 PT and run pre-cut checks (lint/test/ci-matrix)? If green we'll cut and tag RC.

release-bot: Scheduled: will run `release-preflight` at 09:30 PT 2026-03-19 and create branch `release/1.17.0` if checks pass. Results will post to #eng-releases.

Song: I'll watch CI and handle cherry-pick triage. Plan: label backports `backport/1.17.x` and assign owners. Call out any churny PRs for manual review.

Carla: Opening the changelog PR now and adding reviewers @kevin + @maria. I'll include links to PRs in the description.

Maria: Thanks — pinging docs-team to prep a release-notes draft once RC is created. I'll post the cut confirmation here when we have a green preflight. :thumbsup:

release-bot: preflight queued. ETA ~15m after run starts. Will post pass/fail and CI URLs.

Maria: Great. If anyone needs an earlier hotfix window, flag it here by EOD so we can decide whether to include or cut separately.
